findings.title: Gun shield does not follow the weapon's recoil kick
findings.detail: DrawEquipmentAiming adds EquipmentUtility.Recoil's drawOffset/angleOffset to the gun every shot, but DrawShield places the shield from the un-recoiled mountPoint and the bare aim. While firing, the gun twitches under a still shield. If that's unwanted, compute the same Recoil(gun.def, GetRecoilVerb(...), out offset, out angle, aim) in DrawShield and add it to pos/aim. This is cosmetic only.

findings.title: A wrong shieldTexPath only shows up the first time the shield is drawn in play
findings.detail: ShieldGraphic resolves the texture lazily, so a mistyped path in XML (or in a patch from another mod) logs its one 'could not load texture' error only once a mount with a weapon is drawn, not at startup. It logs once and is then cached, so there's no spam. A ConfigErrors override on MountExtension that checks the path isn't empty and the draw size is positive would catch typos at load. This is my opinion; the corpus doesn't settle it.

findings.title: Reinforced mount's art no longer shows which way it faces
findings.detail: The def is still rotatable (inherited), and its firing arc and gunner cell depend on Rotation. But Graphic_Linked.Print prints a 1x1 linked atlas with no rotation and ignores the inherited 1.3 drawSize. Once placed, players can't see which way it faces, only from the arc PlaceWorker while placing it. Vanilla sandbags aren't rotatable, so there's no precedent for this combination.

findings.title: Reinforced mount's description and old saves no longer match the new sandbag recipe
findings.detail: The description still says 'a heavy machined mount with a recoil-absorbing cradle', but the cost fell from 60 metal/stone + 40 steel + 2 components to 5 fabric/leather + 50 steel. Existing mounts in old saves keep their Steel/stone stuff (no load error). colorPerStuff only covers Cloth, so those mounts and leather ones will tint the sandbag atlas in that material's colour.

checked: DrawShield is called only from DrawAt, which vanilla runs only in DrawPhase.Draw on the main thread (Thing.DynamicDrawPhaseAt), so the lazy GraphicDatabase.Get in ShieldGraphic is safe
Shield rotation (AngleAxis(aim)) and the forward offset (RotatedBy(aim)) use the same convention as TurretTop.DrawTurret and DrawEquipmentAiming for a north-pointing texture
The flip range 200–340 matches PawnRenderUtility.DrawEquipmentAiming; plane10Flip mirrors sideways without changing the facing
Altitude: the shield is at mountPoint + 3 AltInc, above the gun (+2) and below the Pawn layer, so the gunner still draws over it
